target_customer: Gamers and gaming communities that organize matches and tournaments
problem: Gaming communities lack easy tools to organize leagues, ladders and tournaments across games.
business_model: Consumer and community platform, monetization not described

founders.name: Ivan Zhou
founders.background_notes: Joined Niantic's Social Platform Product team after the deal (TechCrunch).

founders.name: Anhang Zhu
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as technical founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Cross-game match tracking, leaderboards and chat for several titles requires game integrations and real-time systems.

defensibility.rationale: Tournament tools were offered by existing platforms and no community lock-in is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Niantic bought it on Jan 5 2021 and the standalone product was to be sunset as the team joined Niantic.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence was found beyond the product description on the YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand itself; an unrelated Mayhem Studios appears in search results, which suggests confusion risk.

pivots.from: synced real-time gameplay reviews (per one profile)
pivots.to: community tools for matches, leagues and tournaments
pivots.why: TechCrunch describes a shift to community tools; no reason or date given.

outcome_analysis: Mayhem graduated YC Winter 2018, raised a Series A led by Accel that year, shifted to community tournament tools and was acquired by Niantic in January 2021, with its standalone product sunset and the team absorbed into Niantic's social platform. Terms are undisclosed and the product ended, so this reads as a team landing, though the price is unknown.
notes: mayhem.gg did not resolve from this environment. TechCrunch gives total about $5.7M per Crunchbase; Seedtable splits it into $1.0M seed (2017-12) and $4.7M Series A (2018-08), and CB Insights says $4.7M total, unverified so amounts not recorded. YC page says acquisition in 2020 but the TechCrunch article is dated Jan 2021. Competitor search (Battlefy, Challengermode) found only 2026 pages; list empty.
